title: guettarda polygama
intro: Guettarda polygama, commonly known as the wild jasmine or island jasmine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving fever. The therapeutic actions of Guettarda polygama include its analgesic and antipyretic properties, making it useful in treating pain and fever. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
